title: Awakening
overview: 27th century. A human child awakens, with the mission to find the other humans, and bring peace between them and the mutant Enterrans ruling earth now.

title: Bee-Ware The Hunters
overview: Yakumo and her new friends land in a nest of Enterran bees.

title: Web of Evil
overview: A bunch of Enterrans spiders kidnaps Yakumo in believing a legend that eating a human will make the eater immortal.

title: Day At The Park
overview: Yakumo, Sago and Kutal are invited to join a festival, while Mushra still roams about. When he gets the chance to do a little revenge for being send away, he takes it.

title: Kiri
overview: Mushra finds a human child, who claims to have escaped from a prison for humans.

title: Battling Daku
overview: In an attempt to save Yakumo and Kiri from Daku, Sago comes up with the plan to be captured themselves.

title: Into The Jungle
overview: Kutal's nieces and nephews show up and throw the gang on an unexpected adventure.

title: Reptilers
overview: As Mushra battles Waru, another Enterran named Gyasa, the King of the Snake-Enterrans, appears with the intention of taking out the gang and kidnapping Yakumo.

title: Gyasa
overview: Gyasa uses dirty tricks to take out Sago and Kutal, leaving Mushra by himself. Can he find a way to defeat Gyasa?

title: Mushrambo: The Ultimate Samurai
overview: Mushrambo is able to defeat Gyasa in his first form, but what will happen when he transforms?

title: Clash of The Hyper Warriors
overview: Mushrambo is overpowered by the Hyper Gyasa. Can he find a way to turn the tide of the battle around?

title: The Test
overview: Darba, the supposed wizard of Shinzo, appears with a proposition for the team, but what are his real intentions?

title: Ryuma, Lord of the Reptiles
overview: The group arrives at another forest after going through the desert, but when Grandora the 3-Headed Ice Dragon attacks the village under Ungra and Ryuma's control, it means trouble for the entire team.

title: Dark Spirit of Destruction
overview: Mushrambo has been turned evil and is now Dark Mushrambo. Can anyone or anything defeat him?

title: Mechano city
overview: The group arrives in a city full of robots, but what will they do when the cops begin to pursue them?

title: The giant robot
overview: What will the robots do when they learn that Yakumo is a human?

title: The great war
overview: Mushra and the robots find out about Yakumo's past and the truth about the robot king, but what happens when Mushra battles Cairis to the end in a one-on-one battle?

title: The secrets of the seven
overview: As a machine is using the egg card's power to revive Mushra, Sago, and Kutal, King Nipper sacrifices his life in an attempt to stop Cairis and prevent him from killing Yakumo.

title: The feathered fiend
overview: Mechano City has been destroyed, so Mushra and company decide to get revenge by attacking the Birdmen colonies. What they find is a new challenge, but can they be successful at overcoming it?

title: The two Mushrambo's
overview: Mushrambo must battle his evil self to prevent the young Yakumo from being killed, but can they succeed without gaining some new powers?

title: The battle of one
overview: The final battle between the two Mushrambo's is at hand, but which side will prevail?

title: A new begining
overview: Mushra is trapped once again, but freed by the mysterious Binka, but when Lanancuras' servants attack them, can they survive without hyper power, or is there another way for Mushra to go hyper?

title: Bear claws
overview: Binka and Mushra search for Sago so Mushrambo can be reformed, but what troubles await them in route?

title: Nightmare dream center
overview: Eilis decides to target Mushra to prevent Mushrambo from ever being reborn. Can the team overcome him and keep Mushra alive?

title: Eillis of the storm
overview: It's Eilis vs. Mushrambo, but who will be the victor?

title: Reviving Yakumo
overview: The group gets trapped in a never ending maze, and their only hope of escape is Yakumo. Can they succeed?

title: Lanancuras arises
overview: It's Yakumo & Mushrambo vs. Lanancuras, but who has the bigger desire to win?

title: Lanancuras unbound
overview: Lanancuras gains his full power and continues the battle against Mushrambo. Who will end up being the victor, especially when it appears that Yakumo is killed.

title: Mushrambo meets his match
overview: Mushrambo continues his battle against Lanancuras, but does he stand a chance without the help of Yakumo and Binka?

title: Mushra's mission
overview: Lanancuras' apparent death was unexpected and he appears to be headed toward being the ruler of the world, but Mushra refuses to give up and calls on a new power source to assist him. Will it be enough to defeat Lanancuras in the end?

title: Soul survivor
overview: With all hope lost, Mushra vows to destroy Lanancuras once and for all, and with the guardian powers revealed he may just succeed. What will happen next?

title: Long live Yakumo
overview: The battle between Mushra and Lanancuras comes to its exciting conclusion, but whose lives will it cost?
